sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the digestive system, especially the stomach. It is useful in cases of nausea and vomiting, particularly that related to pregnancy. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning in the stomach. It is also useful in cases of morning sickness.
sections.Stomach: Intense nausea and vomiting. Persistent vomiting. Morning sickness of pregnancy. Irritation and burning in the stomach. Thirst.
